comment: The data release the « app » workflow and a normal build use (plan 13, A1): every asset of the GitHub Release <tag> of <repo>, pinned by SHA-256 and size. fetch_data_release.py downloads (or takes from --from), checks and unpacks them into src/Data.Build/out/<unpack_to> (null = kept as a file: the espeak-ng source archive, the GPL-3 source offer). The assets are made by package_data_release.py (deterministic zips) from the pinned sources: data-pack.lock.json, the pictures, the « Noms propres » pack, fetch_fonts.py, build_espeak.ps1 (espeak-ng.lock.json), fetch_voices.py (voices.json). A new data release = a new tag (data-YYYY.MM, « .2 » for a second one in the month) and a new lock; a published asset is never replaced.
